guideIntro: The strongest early route is not just merging everything. Keep useful elements available, merge only when it improves the board, and prepare counters before difficult fights.
steps: Learn the four-element counter loop before spending heavily on one unit type.
Merge compatible units when the stronger form improves your current team shape.
Keep a balanced frontline and damage line instead of filling the board with one element.
Use Water against Fire, Fire against Earth, Earth against Air, and Air against Water.
Save resources for combinations that solve the next battle, not just the highest rarity.
